critic.fix_suggestion: Apply a multi-material assignment to the fuselage and wing primitives: set the primary material color of the main body to white (RGB 255,255,255) and create four distinct sub-meshes or vertex-color masks for the tail, wingtips, and fuselage swoosh areas. Assign these specific regions a teal/blue hex code (#007A89) to match the reference accents while maintaining the white base across 85% of the total surface area.

discrepancies.observed: Solid uniform gray material across the entire fuselage and wings.
discrepancies.reference: White base color with blue and teal accents on the tail, wingtips, and fuselage.

discrepancies.observed: Plain gray vertical stabilizer with no markings.
discrepancies.reference: A distinct white 'Koru' symbol inside a blue/teal shape on the vertical stabilizer.
